name: Luminance Weighted MIP Map Filtering
definition: A filtering technique to reduce illumination leaking artifacts in Gaussian MIP map blurring by using an auxiliary mask M to prevent low-standard-deviation pixels from propagating to high MIP levels.
summary: Luminance Weighted MIP Map Filtering reduces illumination leaking artifacts in Gaussian MIP map blurring by using an auxiliary mask to prevent low-standard-deviation pixels from propagating to high MIP levels.
